name: Abbott's Booby
rangeDescription: Christmas island (eastern indian ocean)
description: Gangly, stretched-out-looking black-and-white seabird. Strikingly slender and strange-looking in flight.

name: Sira Barbet
rangeDescription: Southern cerros del sira, ucayali, peru
description: Stunning and rarely seen bird known only from the remote Cerros del Sira range in central Peru, east of the main chain of the Andes. Easily identified by its scarlet crown, breast, and flanks as well as white throat and belly.

name: Sabah Partridge
rangeDescription: Northern borneo (sabah)
description: Intricately-patterned partridge of tropical lowland rainforest. Uncommon and declining throughout its range.

name: Caracas Brushfinch
rangeDescription: Coastal mountains of northern venezuela (aragua, miranda, and distrito federal)
description: Boldly patterned sparrow with black head and white eyebrow. Back and tail olive-yellow, underparts white; black band across chest.

name: Reunion Stonechat
rangeDescription: Réunion (western mascarene islands)
description: A small, chunky robin-like bird. Males are black and white and quite variable, sometimes having a white eyebrow and showing a variable amount of rufous on the underparts.

name: Marañon Spinetail
rangeDescription: Southern ecuador (zamora-chinchipe) to northwestern peru (northern cajamarca)
description: Very shy spinetail restricted to the Marañon Valley of northwestern Peru and extreme southern Ecuador; highly threatened due to ongoing habitat loss. Plumage is mostly gray with chestnut back, wings, and tail.

name: Golden-winged Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Western highlands of vietnam (mount ngoc linh)
description: Restricted to high-elevation forest (above 2,000 meters) in the Annamite Mountains of central Vietnam. Predominantly gray with gold and rusty patches in the wings and tail.

name: Cape Griffon
rangeDescription: Open plains and mountains of southern africa
description: Overall the Cape Griffon is creamy-white, much paler and larger than the White-backed Vulture. At close range, the adult’s eyes are honey-colored, and there is a speckled stripe along the middle of the wing.

name: Narcissus Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Sakhalin to japan; winters to philippines and borneo
description: Small flycatcher. Adult male is splendidly colored with a glowing orange supercilium, throat, and breast set against black upperparts, white underparts, and a white wing patch.

name: Varzea Piculet
rangeDescription: Amazonian brazil (lower rio madeira to far western pará)
description: Tiny, dark brown woodpecker. Plumage varies; typically darker and more unmarked in the east and more barred toward the west, but usually looks scaled with white spots.

name: Sangihe Lilac Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Rainforest of sangihe and siau islands (northeast of sulawesi)
description: A unique forest kingfisher endemic to Sangihe. Largely pale brown with an eye-catching red bill, a prominent dark mask with pale flecks on its upper border, dark wings, and a rufous tail.

name: Tukangbesi Sunbird
rangeDescription: Wakatobi (tukangbesi) islands (off southeastern sulawesi)
description: Tiny and active sunbird of forest edges and open woodlands. Endemic to the Tukangbesi archipelago, off southeastern Sulawesi.

name: Maghreb Owl
rangeDescription: Morocco, algeria, and tunisia
description: Learn about Tawny Owl (Maghreb): explore photos, sounds, and observations collected by birders around the world.

name: Rufous Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Alaska to northwestern usa; winters to southern mexico
description: Adult males are almost entirely orange with bright white chest and some green on the back (can be solid green like Allen's Hummingbird). Throat is iridescent, and depending on the light, can look anywhere from red to orange to yellow to lime green.

name: Brown Songlark
rangeDescription: Australia (except most northern and eastern coastal regions)
description: Large brown songbird with long tail and long, strong legs. Males grayish with brown-edged feathers above, and very dark gray belly, breast, and face in breeding plumage.

name: White-tailed Cisticola
rangeDescription: Southern tanzania (kilombero swamp)
description: A relatively colorful medium-sized, long-tailed cisticola. The center of the tail is blackish, but the tips and edges are white.

name: Cebu Boobook
rangeDescription: Philippines (cebu)
description: A medium-sized owl of wooded areas on the island of Cebu. Head and upperparts dark brown and indistinctly barred.

name: Javan Tesia
rangeDescription: Montane forest of java
description: Tiny short-tailed ground-dweller, restricted to foothill and montane forests on Java. Favors areas with dense, tangled undergrowth, in which it bounces around actively.

name: Lompobattang Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Mountains of southern sulawesi
description: A dull warbler restricted to southwestern Sulawesi with a pale eyebrow and central crown stripe, a largely blackish bill, dark legs, dingy olive-brown upperparts, and a pale yellow underside. Found in forests and edges in hills and mountains, often accompanying mixed-species flocks.

name: Speke's Weaver
rangeDescription: Southern ethiopia to somalia, kenya, and northern tanzania
description: A chunky, short-tailed, long-billed weaver of dry country. Breeding males are mostly yellow with a black face mask, a pale eye, and a heavily streaked back.
